Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

OKX's Trading Products team owns the core trading experience across Spot, Margin, and Perpetual/Futures — spanning the full user journey from pre-trade decision-making, through order execution, to post-trade settlement and risk management. As our trading volumes and product complexity continue to grow globally, we are looking for a Trading Product Manager who can own and evolve both the user-facing trading experience and the underlying trading mechanics that power it.
This role sits at the intersection of product design and trading logic. You will work on how users discover, price, place, and manage trades (pre-trade / trade / post-trade), while also owning the correctness and soundness of the core mechanisms beneath the surface — margin models, funding rate formulas, liquidation logic, risk parameter design, and order/matching behavior. You will work closely with engineering, risk, quant, and design teams to ship trading features that are intuitive for users and rigorous under the hood.

What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Start from users and the market to uncover real trading-experience needs — Continuously surface user pain points through user research, behavioral data, community feedback, and conversations with active traders, ensuring product direction is grounded in real signal rather than internal assumptions.
  • Benchmark against industry best practices to build best-in-class trading product competitiveness — Continuously track developments in crypto and traditional finance markets and the latest moves from leading products, translating external insight into concrete product opportunities that keep our trading experience and competitiveness ahead of the industry.
  • Build and continuously refine the end-to-end trading experience — Own the full journey across pre-trade (market data presentation, decision-support tools, leverage/margin setup, risk disclosures), trade (order flow, execution feedback, order book/depth interaction), and post-trade (position management, PnL display, settlement statements) — from defining requirements through to shipping the solution.
  • Drive efficient cross-team collaboration with mature program-management execution — Bring a complete product methodology, independently write rigorous PRDs, and lead alignment and coordination across engineering, risk, quant, design, and compliance. Own the full project lifecycle — from requirements definition and solution design, through development scheduling, to launch validation and post-launch review — ensuring every stage closes the loop with a clear outcome, without relying on others to drive progress.
  • Apply rigorous quantitative thinking to understand and reason about trading mechanics — Bring strong logical reasoning and quantitative analysis skills, with the ability to learn fast and quickly master core trading mechanisms such as margin, leverage, funding rates, and liquidation. Candidates with a deep understanding of trading systems are preferred.

What We Look For In You 

We are open to two types of candidates for this role:

(a) Experienced Trading Practitioners
  • Prior hands-on experience in trading — either within crypto (exchange product, quant, trading desk) or in traditional finance (equities, futures, FX, derivatives) — with direct exposure to how trading products and mechanisms are designed and operated.
  • Solid understanding of core trading concepts: margin/leverage, order types, market microstructure, risk management, and P&L mechanics.
  • Comfortable reading and reasoning through trading formulas (e.g. mark price, funding rate, liquidation price) and translating them into clear product logic.
(b) High-Potential Talent
  • Strong quantitative/analytical foundation — a background in mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, with strong academic performance.
  • High self-drive and fast learning ability — demonstrated track record of picking up complex, technical domains quickly and independently, even without prior trading experience.
  • Genuine intellectual curiosity about financial markets and trading mechanics, with the rigor to work through formulas and edge cases rather than relying on surface-level understanding.
Common requirements for both profiles:
  • 3+ years of product management experience (or equivalent hands-on experience in quant/trading roles for candidates from profile (a)).
  • Strong technical intuition — comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers, and reasoning through quantitative models. You don't need to be a developer, but you think with the rigor of one.
  • Excellent communication skills — able to write a precise, technically sound PRD, and to explain complex trading mechanics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High agency and execution velocity — comfortable operating in ambiguity, moving from open question to shipped solution, and making decisions with incomplete information.
  • Genuine passion for crypto and trading — actively uses trading products, understands order types and market microstructure, and can explain how margin, leverage, or liquidation mechanics work. Ideally, you have skin in the game.
  • Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R&D center.

Nice-To-Haves 

  • Experience with derivatives products (perpetual futures, options) either as a builder or an active trader.
  • Familiarity with risk parameter design (margin tiers, liquidation engines, insurance funds) at an exchange or financial institution.
  • Quantitative modeling experience (e.g. Python, SQL) sufficient to validate trading formulas or backtest mechanism changes.
  • Prior work in a high-growth crypto exchange, trading firm, or fintech company.
  • Fluency in English is preferred to better support communication with global product and business stakeholders.

Perks & Benefits 

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

Key Responsibilities

    As an App Developer Senior Manager, you will be the core leader of the company’s app development business, responsible for formulating the app development strategy, technical roadmap, and work plan, aligning with the company’s business development goals and regulatory requirements. You will oversee the entire lifecycle of app development, including demand analysis, technical architecture design, development implementation, testing, launch, iteration, and maintenance, focusing on meeting the functional needs of core business links such as digital currency spot trading, derivative trading, fund recharge and withdrawal, and user asset management. This role requires in-depth understanding of mobile app development technologies, rich team management experience, strong technical research and development capabilities, and familiarity with app security and compliance requirements related to digital assets, to ensure the company’s mobile apps are stable, efficient, secure, and compliant.

    Key Responsibilities

    1. App Development Strategy & Technical Planning

  • Formulate the company’s app development strategy, technical roadmap, and annual/quarterly development plan, combining the company’s business needs (digital currency trading, payment settlement) and industry technical trends (cross-platform development, app security, user experience optimization).
  • Determine the app technical architecture, development framework, and technology stack (such as iOS: Swift, Android: Kotlin/Java, cross-platform: Flutter/React Native), optimize the technical architecture, and ensure the scalability, maintainability, and security of the app.
  • Research and introduce advanced app development technologies, tools, and methodologies, promote technical innovation and optimization, improve development efficiency and product quality, and enhance the company’s app technical competitiveness.
  • Coordinate with the product team to clarify app functional requirements, convert business needs into technical solutions, and formulate detailed development plans and schedules.

    • 2. Full Lifecycle App Development Management

  • Oversee the entire lifecycle of app development, including demand review, technical design, coding development, unit testing, integration testing, UAT testing, and launch, ensuring that the development work is completed on time, with quality and quantity.
  • Supervise the development of core app functions, including digital currency trading interface, order execution, fund management, user authentication, message push, and security encryption, ensuring that functions meet business requirements and regulatory standards.
  • Manage app iteration and maintenance work, collect user feedback and technical problems, formulate iteration plans, fix online bugs in a timely manner, and continuously optimize app performance and user experience.
  • Coordinate with the test team to formulate test plans and test standards, supervise the test process, ensure that the app meets quality requirements before launch, and reduce online risks.
  • Manage app release and update work, handle release processes in major app stores (App Store, Huawei AppGallery, Xiaomi App Store, etc.), and ensure the smooth launch and update of the app.

    • 3. App Security & Compliance Management

  • Establish and improve the app security management system, formulate app security standards and specifications, and ensure that the app meets data security, user privacy protection, and digital asset security requirements.
  • Oversee app security development, conduct regular security audits and vulnerability scans, identify and fix security risks (such as data leakage, malicious attacks, and tampering), and ensure the security of user assets and transaction data.
  • Ensure that app development and operation comply with global regulatory requirements (FATF, MiCA, local regulations) and app store review rules, handle compliance-related issues, and avoid regulatory risks and app removal risks.
  • Cooperate with the compliance and risk control teams to complete app compliance reviews, regulatory filings, and security assessments, and provide relevant technical materials and explanations.

    • 4. Team Management & Development

  • Build, manage, and develop the app development team, formulate team OKRs, performance assessment standards, and talent training plans, and improve the team’s professional capabilities (app development, technical research, problem solving, etc.).
  • Arrange daily work assignments for the team, supervise work progress, solve technical difficulties in the development process, and create a positive and collaborative technical team atmosphere.
  • Guide team members’ professional growth, organize technical training, technical sharing, and skill assessments, cultivate technical backbones, and build a professional app development talent echelon.
  • Manage team performance, conduct regular performance reviews, motivate team members to achieve work goals, and retain core technical talents.

    • 5. Cross-departmental Collaboration & Technical Support

  • Communicate closely with product, trading, compliance, risk control, operations, and other departments to understand business needs, coordinate app development-related work, and ensure that app development is closely aligned with business development.
  • Cooperate with the backend development team to ensure the smooth docking of app and backend systems, and solve interface docking and data interaction problems.
  • Provide technical support for other departments, answer app-related technical questions, assist in solving app-related problems in business operations, and support the promotion and operation of the app.
  • Communicate with external technical partners (app stores, security service providers, etc.) to handle technical cooperation and coordination matters.

    • 6. Project & Budget Management

  • Manage app development projects, formulate project plans, control project progress, cost, and quality, identify project risks, and put forward targeted risk mitigation measures.
  • Formulate the app development team’s budget plan, control development costs, reasonably allocate resources, and improve resource utilization efficiency.
  • Track and analyze project execution, conduct project summary and review, summarize experience and lessons, and continuously optimize project management processes.

Requirements

     
    1. Experience: 7+ years of mobile app development and management work experience, including 3+ years of app development team management experience; preferred experience in fintech, digital currency, payment, or internet financial institutions. Deep understanding of app development processes, technical architecture, and digital asset-related business models, with experience in leading the development and launch of large-scale mobile apps.
    2. Professional Expertise:
      1. Proficient in mobile app development technologies, familiar with at least one of the mainstream development frameworks (iOS: Swift; Android: Kotlin/Java; cross-platform: Flutter/React Native), with rich practical development experience.
      2. Familiar with app technical architecture design, performance optimization, security encryption, and interface docking technologies, able to solve complex technical problems in app development.
      3. Familiar with app store review rules and compliance requirements, with experience in app release, update, and maintenance in major app stores.
      4. Familiar with digital currency exchange-related business (spot trading, derivative trading, fund recharge and withdrawal), able to convert business needs into technical solutions.
      5. Proficient in agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), able to manage app development projects efficiently; familiar with project management tools (Jira, Trello, etc.) and code management tools (Git, SVN, etc.).
    3. Leadership & Management: Excellent leadership and team management capabilities, able to build and lead a high-performance app development team; strong work organization, coordination, and decision-making capabilities.
    4. Technical Research & Innovation: Strong technical sensitivity and learning ability, able to track industry technical trends, research and introduce advanced technologies, and promote technical innovation and optimization.
    5. Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Chinese and English, able to effectively communicate with cross-departmental colleagues, external partners, and team members.
    6. Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related fields; relevant professional certifications (such as PMP, CKAD, CKA) are preferred.

    Preferred Qualifications

  • Has app development management experience in compliant digital currency exchanges, familiar with the development needs of digital currency trading apps and related compliance requirements.
  • Has experience in leading cross-platform app development projects (Flutter/React Native), with rich experience in app performance optimization and security reinforcement.
  • Has experience in handling app security incidents and regulatory compliance reviews, and is proficient in solving app-related security and compliance problems.
  • Familiar with blockchain technology and digital asset underlying logic, able to combine technical iteration to optimize app functions and user experience.

descriptions.job-17m643m:
ABOUT HUT 8

Imagine the ultimate destination for those who want to work at the cutting edge of technology, energy, and infrastructure. Hut 8 is on a mission to build and operate some of the world’s largest data centers for next-generation computing workloads, including AI, Colocation, Cloud, and Bitcoin Mining. We are proud to offer interesting and challenging opportunities for individuals who want to build teams, solve problems, and make an impact from day one. If you’re an ambitious individual looking for a career that is as rewarding as it is challenging, you’ve come to the right place.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
The Digital Delivery Principal is the strategic owner of how Hut 8 creates, coordinates, and governs digital project data across its growing portfolio of data center and energy infrastructure programs. This role goes beyond traditional BIM management — it encompasses the full digital delivery lifecycle, from model creation and clash coordination through asset naming governance, CMMS planning, and digital twin strategy. Operating at the intersection of construction technology and operational readiness, the Digital Delivery Principal ensures that every digital artifact produced during design and construction is accurate, standards-compliant, and structured to serve the organization long after project handover.
Key responsibilities include:
• Develop and enforce Hut 8’s BIM Execution Plan (BEP), establishing enterprise-wide standards for model creation, file structures, naming conventions, and data interoperability across all active and future projects • Own the configuration and governance of Autodesk Construction Cloud — managing user permissions, submittal workflows, model publishing protocols, and issue tracking to ensure a disciplined, auditable digital environment • Build and maintain Hut 8’s digital delivery framework, defining how project data is created, coordinated, reviewed, and handed over across internal teams and external partners including EPC contractors and design consultants • Lead clash detection and model coordination efforts, identifying and resolving spatial conflicts across architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing disciplines before they impact field execution • Drive CMMS planning and asset data integration strategies, ensuring that digital models and asset naming conventions are structured to transition seamlessly from construction tools to operational maintenance systems at project handover • Align document and asset naming standards across all digital delivery platforms in coordination with the Document Control function, enforcing consistency across SharePoint, ACC, and downstream systems • Evaluate and integrate emerging digital delivery technologies — including digital twins, CFD modeling, reality capture, and AI-assisted coordination tools — recommending strategic adoptions that advance Hut 8’s competitive position • Deliver tailored training programs to internal stakeholders and external partners, building organizational fluency in BIM tools, ACC workflows, and digital delivery standards • Conduct regular audits and quality assurance reviews of BIM models and datasets to maintain accuracy, completeness, and adherence to project and enterprise standards • And other duties as assigned
 
ABOUT YOU

To thrive in this role, you bring:
• Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field • 4+ years of experience in BIM management, digital delivery, or project controls within industrial, energy, or data center sectors • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Construction Cloud, including workflow customization, permissions management, submittal processes, and model coordination • Working knowledge of Revit, Navisworks, Revizto, or comparable BIM and model coordination platforms • Familiarity with CMMS platforms and how asset data structures translate from design and construction environments into operational maintenance systems • Understanding of ISO 19650 principles and their practical application in project data management and digital delivery governance • Experience developing and enforcing BIM Execution Plans across multi-disciplinary project teams, including coordination with external EPC partners • Exposure to digital twin development, CFD modeling, or reality capture technologies is a strong plus • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to process improvement, comfortable operating across both strategic planning and hands-on technical execution • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex digital delivery concepts into clear standards and training materials for diverse audiences

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WHAT MAKES HUT 8 A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

Hut 8 offers a benefits and wellness program that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as paid time off. We are proud to invest in building the best team in the industry. At all levels of the organization, we are driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, radical transparency, and relentless growth mentality.

At Hut 8, you will have the opportunity to:

▶ Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting

▶ Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government

▶ Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team

▶ Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Principal Engineer with a deep expertise in autonomous AI agent architecture and deployment, to spearhead the design, development, and optimization of intelligent agent systems on our global crypto exchange platform. This is a senior role requiring a hands-on AI science background combined with strategic oversight, technical direction, and cross-functional collaboration.
 
You will work at the cutting edge of AI and crypto, designing AI agents that can autonomously reason, act, and evolve in complex, real-time environments such as trading, security, compliance, and customer interaction.

What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Lead the design, development, and lifecycle management of autonomous AI agents tailored to crypto exchange operations (e.g., customer assistant, trading bots, risk detection agents, fraud prevention agents, etc.).
  • Architect multi-agent systems (MAS) and frameworks to support goal-directed, reasoning, planning, and reinforcement-learning-based agents.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, business, and operation teams to define agent roles and measurable KPIs.
  • Drive experimentation, simulations, and continuous learning pipelines for agent performance optimization.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on developments in AGI, LLM-integrated agents, and cognitive architectures; apply relevant innovations to production systems.
  • Mentor and lead a team of AI scientists and engineers; help define the AI roadmap and research strategy.
  • Ensure system scalability, security, and regulatory compliance of AI-powered solutions in the crypto exchange domain.

What We Look For In You 

  • 10+ years of industry experience in a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of advanced degree (PhD/Master's in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Robotics, or related field) and industry experience.

  • Proven experience building and deploying autonomous AI agents in live environments. Ideal candidates will have:
    • Designed multi-agent frameworks or agent ecosystems (e.g., AutoGPT, OpenAgents, LangGraph, LangFuse, Dify, Coze, etc.).
    • Experience with goal-oriented agents, context engineering, memory management, tool use, and RL-based decision making.
    • Developed agents for real-time decision-making, such as trading, gaming, customer support, or operations.
    • Track record of delivering end-to-end AI systems in fast-paced, high-scale environments (preferably finance, crypto, or high-frequency domains).

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in top-tier AI labs or Tech industry leaders
  • Experience in high-frequency trading, fintech, Web3, or crypto platforms is a strong advantage
  • Startups or research-intensive environments preferred; must be comfortable operating with ambiguity and speed

OKX Statement

The salary range for this position is $250,444.00 to $375,666.00. The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Applicants should apply via Okcoin and OKX internal or external careers site.
 
OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your mission

As a Trading Operations Specialist at Bitpanda, your mission is to ensure a secure and smooth trading experience. You are well-versed in the foundations of financial instruments and trading systems and also possess a very strong, problem-solving-oriented mindset.

What you’ll do 

  • Deep-dive into and quick understanding of our financial products, trading and hedging systems
  • Handle market alerts and execute OTC trades & blockchain transactions on behalf of Bitpanda
  • Perform daily settlement and reconciliation of trades 
  • Monitor hedging and trading activity and maintain the relevant risk parameter settings; you will be the first line of defence for the sanity of our trading and hedging operations
  • Proactively document and improve processes & recommend system developments

Who you are

  • Experience in trading operations or a similar area (trader certificate is a plus); you should have a great understanding of and/or interest in financial markets, particularly equities or cryptocurrencies/blockchain
  • Ability to identify problems and solve them quickly or escalate them as necessary
  • Strong data investigation skills (MS Excel in particular and SQL or working with databases is a plus; experience with Bloomberg, Refinitiv (Reuters) or FactSet is welcome)
  • Great team player with strong attention to detail, excellent organizational and communication skills (English is a must), thriving in an ever-changing environment
  • Ability to work in night shift (00:00-07:00) to ensure operational continuity in a 24/7 business

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

Blockstream was founded in 2014 by Dr. Adam Back and a group of fellow cryptographers and engineers who were passionate about Bitcoin and its potential to change the future of finance. Focusing on building fundamental Bitcoin infrastructure, Blockstream quickly became one of the industry's leading technology powerhouses.

Blockstream is transforming traditional financial systems by equipping enterprises and consumers with Bitcoin-based solutions that enhance efficiency, security, and scalability. Our vision is to empower the world with tools that strengthen financial security, streamline everyday use, and unlock new opportunities for growth. 

In pursuit of our expansive vision, we’ve built a full stack of innovative products on top of the Bitcoin protocol, from layer-2 projects like Liquid and Core Lightning, to end-user software and hardware wallets like Green and Jade. As a QA Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and executing test strategies to ensure the stability and performance of our Bitcoin and blockchain-based applications. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and devops engineers to identify issues early, automate testing processes, and maintain high-quality standards for our products.

  • Understanding of security testing methodologies, including penetration testing and vulnerability assessments.

descriptions.job-135qu6a:
To increase bandwidth and reduce latency for distributed systems worldwide, the DoubleZero Foundation and Malbec Labs need the best talent from across Web3 and beyond.

We know that the best people often have varied backgrounds, and as a new venture, we are open to hiring motivated folks who can create their own role and make a huge impact. At this stage in our development, we need experienced senior leaders that can come in and take ownership of broad functional areas to supercharge our growth.

If you want to be a part of helping blockchains fulfill their potential and impact billions of people around the world, let us know by filling out the application below. Share what grabbed your attention in the whitepaper, what excites you the most about DoubleZero, and how you would help this project move faster and reach the communities that will benefit.

We look forward to hearing from you!

ABOUT DOUBLEZERO

DoubleZero is a high-performance, permissionless global network purpose-built for distributed systems. The mission is simple: increase bandwidth and reduce latency.

DoubleZero increases bandwidth by filtering junk data that currently plagues validators and other network operators. DoubleZero reduces latency by connecting these filters via underutilized private fiber links, forming a mesh network. By combining these improvements and routing the right data through optimized, low-latency paths, the DoubleZero protocol empowers blockchains and other systems to achieve performance levels previously impossible.

In short, DoubleZero is a new Internet for distributed systems. It is supported by many independent contributors. Among them, DoubleZero Foundation drives the adoption, decentralization, security, and advancement of the protocol. Malbec Labs develops the technical components of the protocol itself. We look forward to hearing from you.
